title: Charlie's Adventure
description:
Take on the role of Charlie and enter a strange world overrun by hordes of zombies, deadly traps, and unexpected dangers.

Fight your way through a series of platforming challenges, eliminate waves of undead enemies, and use the environment to your advantage. Master a variety of skills and abilities as you help Charlie cleanse his world of the zombie infestation.

Features• 12 unique levels.

• Dozens of zombie enemies.

• Deadly traps that can eliminate both you and your enemies.

• Use the environment as part of your strategy.

• Easy to learn, difficult to master gameplay.

• 3 difficulty levels.

• Full controller support.

• Customizable key bindings for keyboard, mouse, and joystick.

• Support for Ultra HD (4K) resolution.

Help Charlie survive the nightmare and rid his world of the undead.
